facts.fact: 兄弟手语开场：Nikolas 拔矛悬空——拽右耳——「I’m all right.」——「They may as well have been in the training grounds of Cyr villa, facing their father two to one.」
王座共振：Dawn Throne 认他如认「like meets like」——「in a flash of understanding, how they fit together. And how they could break.」——「Weaken the throne, then weaken the body.」
facts.anchor: Weaken the throne, then weaken the body.

facts.fact: 拒绝附身：Voice 劝降（No need for grief, or fear）——「Back in Noctus, Phos had made him so many promises」——「I crave freedom from you」——枪击后脑被吸收反捉。
三号机动：Nikolas 断翼救弟——「THIRD MANEUVER」——换位机动复刻童年（switched…trade places）——Rian:「He would follow his brother's orbit across the sky no matter what horizon it led them to.」
一枪开胸：脉动复现（fever 时神应答的旧感）——「Never again.」——Taesia 先以剑抵其喉护场——Rian 抬手（父亲的手）以 lightspeed 换枪开火——「A thousand extinction events in a single drop of ichor.」
facts.anchor: A thousand extinction events in a single drop of ichor.

facts.fact: 爆炸护盾：双阳化二十化百——Taesia 覆身护弟——「Anyone home?」「Just me.」——双阳归位、Third 永不再升。
揭底：Risha 耗尽魂弹——「Phos today, and Thana tomorrow.」——Rian 问「Why was it only me and Ulshära?」——「Because he couldn’t. Phos didn't put his fulcrum in the spear.」——「Phos put his fulcrum into Nik.」
Angelica 自白：「I don't have to be afraid of Deia anymore. With this power, I can make Deia afraid of me.」——Nyx oddly silent（Taesia 察觉）。
facts.anchor: With this power, I can make Deia afraid of me.
